meta.name: deslop
meta.description: Anti-slop frontend skill — reads the brief, infers design direction, ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check. Covers typography, layout, motion, accessibility, dark mode, and premium design taste. Ported from leonxlnx/taste-skill (53k★ GitHub).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出不撞模板、有质感的界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让网站或应用看起来不像是套用模板的
copy.tagline_en: Create distinctive interfaces with real taste, no template look.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build websites or apps and want them to look custom-made, not templated.

howto.what: 当用户给出页面需求时,Claude会先判断页面类型和风格,再按反模板规则设计,产出不像AI模板的界面;改版时先审计再动手,交付前做强制检查,覆盖排版、布局、动效等。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作着陆页、作品集或网站改版,并提供了页面类型、风格描述或参考链接时触发;技能不会自动运行,需要先读取brief。

say.text: 帮我做一个SaaS着陆页,风格要Linear那种,简洁冷静
say.note: Claude会按简洁风格设定旋钮,并给出设计方向

say.text: 这是我们现有官网,我想改版,但保留品牌调性
say.note: 改版会先审计,再决定保留还是重做

say.text: 做一个作品集页面,偏编辑杂志风,用衬线字体
say.note: 会采用编辑排版,配衬线字体和不对称布局

howto.what_en: Claude reads the brief, infers page type and style, then ships non-templated UI via anti-slop rules. Redesigns are audit-first; pre-flight check before ship. Covers typography, layout, motion, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a landing page, portfolio, or redesign and provides page type, style words, or reference links. It never fires automatically; the brief is read first.

say_en.text: Help me build a SaaS landing page, Linear-style, clean and calm
say_en.note: Sets the dials for minimalism and outputs a design read

say_en.text: Here's our current site; I want a redesign but keep the brand identity
say_en.note: Audits first, then decides preserve vs overhaul

say_en.text: Make a portfolio page with an editorial magazine feel, serif type
say_en.note: Uses editorial layout with serif and asymmetric grid
